identification: Regency/early Victorian style figured (tiger/fiddleback) satinwood work or sewing table, trestle end supports on ebonised stretcher and bun feet, frieze drawer and velvet-lined sliding sewing bag. Possibly c1850, could be later revival. Veneer chips, one knob missing, faded bag.

viewing_check: Check veneer is genuine tiger satinwood (not stained maple/birch), age of construction (hand-cut dovetails in drawer, saw marks), whether the top veneer chips and missing knob are repairable, bag condition and whether the bun feet and ebonised stretcher are original. Photograph drawer interior and underside.
